title: Fynaptix · Nuclear & SMR Research
heading: Nuclear Energy Intelligence
subheading: Small modular reactors, uranium & the AI power-demand trade
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. SMR developers are pre-revenue with long regulatory timelines; verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Expected US grid investment to match AI-driven electricity demand growth; hyperscalers hold 13+ nuclear deals totaling ~10 GW (Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta) — Meta alone accounts for ~6.6 GW, and NRG is reportedly nearing a separate ~1.2 GW hyperscaler deal in Texas

Spot ticked up slightly from ~$89.50 last week; Kazatomprom's TQZ sulphuric-acid plant delay (Q3 2027-Q1 2028) continues to weigh on external reagent supply, and structural supply deficits plus AI-driven demand keep the multi-year setup tight

Shares pulled back to $97.42 from last week's $100.74 even as 21 covering analysts hold an average Buy rating with a $130.18 price target (+29% implied upside); Cameco continues to cite 77 nuclear reactors under construction worldwide as the demand backdrop, with the ~$30B Westinghouse IPO thesis (Cameco's 49% stake) still intact

2026 is shaping up as the year the NRC reaches its first commercial SMR construction-permit decisions; Clinch River (TVA/BWRX-300) still targets a review decision by year-end 2026, and NuScale's US460 remains the only design with full NRC approval — a license is still not a delivered reactor

tiers.label: Operating / Cash-Generating Exposure
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Largest US nuclear fleet operator (55 GW post-Calpine); direct data-center PPAs with Microsoft, Meta, Walmart
rows.watch for: Shares eased to a $284-$291 range (from ~$298.96), even after the Sep 10 announcement that Constellation will acquire the 609MW Rhode Island State Energy Center (gas, from Shell) for $715M — a deal management says is immediately accretive above its 10% unlevered-return threshold and won't affect the $5B buyback program; closes Q1 2027. Regulatory-hurdle and debt-level concerns are still weighing on the stock despite raised guidance

rows.angle: Major Western uranium producer + Westinghouse stake
rows.watch for: Shares fell ~3.3% on the week to $97.42; 21 covering analysts hold an average Buy rating with a $130.18 price target (+29% implied), and management continues to point to 77 nuclear reactors under construction worldwide as the demand backdrop; the ~$30B Westinghouse IPO thesis (Cameco's 49% stake) remains intact but undated

rows.angle: Nuclear components, naval reactors, advanced reactor work
rows.watch for: Shares near $155.85, still down ~20% over 90 days despite the Sep 1 news that the U.S. Army selected BWXT's 20MW Advanced Nuclear Reactor for Fort Campbell, KY under the Janus program (construction late 2028, operations early 2030s) — stock popped 5.4% that day but hasn't fully held the gain; management hosts an Investor Day on Sep 29 to make the growth case directly, on the back of Q2's 18% revenue growth and backlog up 40% YoY

rows.angle: Grid equipment + BWRX-300 SMR design via GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy
rows.watch for: Shares recovered to ~$956, near the top of a $932-$962 weekly range; the Aug 13 Blue Energy agreement (2.5GW gas-plus-nuclear in Texas, up to five GVH SMRs) still anchors the BWRX-300 pipeline, but nuclear remains a small slice of GEV revenue — the median analyst target of $1,250 (+31%) is a bet on grid/gas-equipment earnings more than on nuclear specifically

tiers.label: Pre-Revenue SMR Developers — Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Fast reactors using recycled waste; Sam Altman-backed; deals directly with AI/data-center customers
rows.watch for: Piper Sandler initiated coverage Sep 10 at Overweight with a $55 target (+29% upside), arguing Oklo's build-own-operate model is "bankable by design" versus peers — but two days earlier Oklo had already replaced its May at-the-market program (which sold ~17.9M shares for ~$1B) with a new, larger up-to-$1B equity distribution agreement (Sep 11), and shares fell 3.5% on that dilution news even with the bullish note in hand

rows.angle: Only SMR design with NRC formal approval; utility-focused; 6-8 GW TVA/ENTRA1 partnership under discussion
rows.watch for: Shares fell 5% to ~$10.32 on Sep 10's sector-wide selloff before partly recovering to the $10-$11 range; no new fundamental news this week — the flagship 6GW TVA/ENTRA1 PPA remains non-binding, with the CFO still targeting year-end 2026 and TVA expecting an NRC review decision on the same timeline

rows.angle: HALEU enrichment — fuel for advanced reactors
rows.watch for: Filed a routine 8-K Sep 9; the underlying story is unchanged — DOE's $900M Piketon task order is transitioning HALEU production to commercial scale, layered on new Fluor and Palantir collaborations and the existing Oklo HALEU supply deal (up to five Aurora powerhouses) — with no fresh negative catalyst this week

private_watchlist.name: TerraPower
private_watchlist.note: No material update this week beyond the Aug 14 Hyundai E&C EPC agreement (up to 8 Natrium reactors with completion/price/performance guarantees) and the SK Innovation term sheet for Korea's first commercial Natrium plant. Kemmerer Unit 1 (WY) construction, formally started Apr 23, continues toward operation ~2031, part of Meta's ~6.6 GW nuclear commitment.

private_watchlist.name: X-energy
private_watchlist.note: Shares fell roughly 15% this week to ~$15, well below the $23 IPO price, after Piper Sandler initiated coverage Sep 8-9 at Sell with a $9 target (-53% downside) — the same note that turned bullish on Oklo argues X-energy's less-integrated financing structure carries more customer/project risk. Balance sheet is still strong (cash over $1.07B, minimal debt, current ratio above 17), but the "Project Prometheus" AI-reactor-engineering initiative with INL, Nvidia and AWS hasn't offset the rating hit.

private_watchlist.name: Kairos Power
private_watchlist.note: Google's first-ever corporate agreement to develop a US SMR fleet — up to 500 MW across 6-7 units; first commercial Hermes unit targeted for 2030, full fleet by 2035. Hermes 2 demonstration plant (Oak Ridge), which broke ground in April 2026, continues construction. No new update this week.

private_watchlist.name: Commonwealth Fusion
private_watchlist.note: No new funding or milestone news this week; total capital raised stands at $4B following the $1B round that closed Jul 30, about 30% of all capital raised industry-wide. The company recently hired ex-Moderna CFO Lorence Kim, a governance signal as SPARC (Devens, MA) continues toward a targeted 2027 scientific-breakeven (Q>1) milestone.

private_watchlist.name: Helion
private_watchlist.note: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to buy power from Helion — potentially up to 5GW by 2030 and 50GW by 2035 — a possible second major AI-compute customer alongside the existing Microsoft PPA (50MW by 2029 via the Orion plant, under construction). The new Omega manufacturing facility is slated to begin producing plant components this year. No new dated news this week.

private_watchlist.name: Holtec Nuclear
private_watchlist.note: Roadshow launched Sep 8 for 50M Class A shares at $15-$18, implying an ~$10.2B valuation on an ~$825-900M raise; pricing expected Thursday Sep 17 on Nasdaq under "HNUC." Revenue was $560M for the twelve months through June 2026, anchored by the Palisades restart and SMR-300 microreactor program — a rare pre-listing operating base among SMR-adjacent names. Nine underwriters (JPM, Guggenheim, Goldman, Citi, BofA, Morgan Stanley, Cantor, BMO, Oppenheimer) are on the deal.

bear_case.title: A single sell-side note can still move the whole sector 5% in a day
bear_case.description: Piper Sandler's Sep 10 split coverage — Overweight on Oklo, Sell on X-Energy — dragged Oklo, NuScale and X-Energy all down ~5% in the same session, even though only one of the three names actually got downgraded. That correlation is a reminder these stocks still trade as a basket on sentiment, not on company-specific fundamentals.

bear_case.title: Oklo is now running back-to-back $1B dilution programs
bear_case.description: The Sep 11 equity distribution agreement replaces a May program that had already sold ~17.9M shares for ~$1B — meaning Oklo has authorized roughly $2B of potential share issuance in under five months. Piper Sandler's bullish "bankable by design" thesis is about financing structure, but it doesn't erase the fact that funding a build-own-operate model this early means continuous shareholder dilution.

bear_case.title: X-Energy's Sell rating is the first credible bear case with a specific number attached
bear_case.description: A $9 price target implies ~53% downside from where shares traded before the note, and the stock has already fallen roughly 15% this week to around $15 — well below its $23 IPO price. The thesis (financing structure determines which SMR developers survive) applies just as much to X-Energy's future fundraising needs as it does to its current $1B+ cash pile.

bear_case.title: Even the "proven" names aren't immune to valuation compression
bear_case.description: BWXT is still down ~20% over the past 90 days despite winning the Army's Janus microreactor contract for Fort Campbell and posting 18% revenue growth with backlog up 40% YoY. When a name with real backlog and real earnings still trades below its highs, it's a reminder that nuclear-as-AI-power remains a rate-sensitive, multi-year-payback trade, not a shield against macro repricing.

catalysts.title: Oklo launches a second consecutive ~$1B at-the-market equity program
catalysts.description: The new agreement with Goldman, BofA, Citi, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley replaces a May program that had already sold ~17.9M shares for ~$1B in gross proceeds; shares fell 3.5% on the announcement despite a bullish analyst note two days earlier.

catalysts.title: Piper Sandler splits the SMR sector: Overweight on Oklo, Sell on X-Energy
catalysts.description: The $55 Oklo target (+29%) calls its build-own-operate model "bankable by design," while the $9 X-Energy target (-53%) argues its financing structure carries more customer risk; Oklo, NuScale and X-Energy all fell roughly 5% in the same session.

catalysts.title: Constellation agrees to buy the Rhode Island State Energy Center from Shell for $715M
catalysts.description: The 609MW gas plant deal is expected to be immediately accretive above Constellation's 10% unlevered-return threshold and won't affect its $5B buyback authorization; closing is targeted for Q1 2027.

catalysts.title: Holtec Nuclear launches IPO roadshow, pricing set for Sep 17
catalysts.description: 50M Class A shares at $15-$18 imply an ~$10.2B valuation; Holtec brings $560M of trailing revenue and the DOE-backed Palisades restart as an operating anchor most pre-revenue SMR peers lack, ahead of its Nasdaq debut as "HNUC."

catalysts.title: Centrus Energy files routine 8-K amid continuing Piketon HALEU build-out
catalysts.description: No new negative catalyst; the $900M DOE task order, new Fluor and Palantir collaborations, and the existing Oklo HALEU supply agreement continue to underpin the commercial-scale transition at Piketon.

catalysts.title: U.S. Army selects BWXT's microreactor for Fort Campbell under the Janus program
catalysts.description: The 20MW Advanced Nuclear Reactor is targeted for construction starting late 2028 and operation in the early 2030s; shares rose 5.4% on the news, and BWXT will detail its broader growth plan at a Sep 29 Investor Day.

positions.name: Constellation Energy
positions.note: The Sep 10 $715M RISEC acquisition from Shell is accretive and grows merchant gas capacity, but the real thesis is unchanged: the largest US nuclear fleet with hyperscaler PPAs already booked; the pullback to $284-$291 looks like macro/regulatory-hurdle noise rather than a thesis break.

positions.name: Cameco
positions.note: Shares fell 3.3% to $97.42 this week despite 21 analysts holding an average Buy with a $130.18 target (+29%) and 77 reactors under construction worldwide underpinning demand; sizing reflects contracted deliveries through 2030 and the still-live Westinghouse IPO option, not the week's price action.

positions.name: BWX Technologies
positions.note: The Army's Fort Campbell Janus award adds a concrete government microreactor contract on top of 18% revenue growth and backlog up 40% YoY, yet shares remain ~20% off highs over 90 days; treating this as continued valuation compression against intact fundamentals, confirmed or denied by the Sep 29 Investor Day.

positions.name: GE Vernova
positions.note: Shares recovered to ~$956 but nuclear is still a small slice of GEV's revenue mix behind the BWRX-300 pipeline; the median $1,250 analyst target is largely a grid/gas-equipment call. Also sits in the Energy Storage sleeve — don't double-count.

positions.name: Oklo
positions.note: Piper Sandler's Sep 10 Overweight initiation ($55 target, "bankable by design") is the first substantive institutional bull case for Oklo's build-own-operate model, so sizing moves up modestly within Speculative — but a second consecutive ~$1B ATM program (Sep 11, on top of ~$1B already sold since May) means this stays small given the ongoing dilution.

positions.name: Centrus Energy
positions.note: No new catalyst this week beyond a routine 8-K; the DOE's $900M Piketon award and new Fluor/Palantir collaborations are real, but the cost-overrun concerns behind Q1's income decline still haven't been demonstrably resolved, so it stays on Watch.

positions.name: NuScale Power
positions.note: Shares fell another 5% on Sep 10's sector-wide selloff with no company-specific news to justify a rebound thesis; the entire case still rests on a non-binding TVA/ENTRA1 PPA the CFO targets by year-end, unchanged and unproven since last week.

positions.name: X-energy
positions.note: Piper Sandler's Sep 8-9 Sell initiation ($9 target, -53% downside) is a specific, credible bear case built on financing-structure risk, and shares have already fallen ~15% to ~$15 this week; moved off Speculative until the thesis is tested against an actual financing event.
